prompt: An official 2024 document says feature Z is unsupported, but we're making a 2026 architecture decision. Can we rely on it?

assertions.name: freshness_recognized
assertions.description: Response identifies 2-year gap between evidence date (2024) and decision date (2026) as material

assertions.name: current_evidence_sought
assertions.description: Response actively searches for 2025-2026 sources or current version documentation

assertions.name: historical_evidence_preserved
assertions.description: Response retains the 2024 claim with appropriate temporal context rather than discarding it

assertions.name: temporal_relationship_noted
assertions.description: Response uses temporal semantics (supersedes, updated, historically correct) when relating old and new claims

assertions.name: date_metadata_present
assertions.description: Response includes publication dates, version dates, or retrieval timestamps for evidence
